'''Scotthx1138''' is a Steam Workshop author who published Star Wars CCG HD (Decipher) Premier-Reflections II (WIP), a table for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="hdwip" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 24 September 2023 &ndash; 3 October 2023 || Published Star Wars CCG HD (Decipher) Premier-Reflections II (WIP), a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="hdwip" />
|}
